$comment: Quality gates for the qa, spec-build and spec-check skills (node .agents/skills/qa/scripts/gates.mjs fast|full) and the Claude Code hooks in .claude/hooks/. `full` runs the Linux job of .github/workflows/ci.yml without its two Xvfb steps (the viewer smoke test and the X11 display-profile test need a display server); those and the Windows and macOS jobs run in CI only (AGENTS.md §10); `fast` runs in the Stop hook, filtered by `paths` (prefixes of changed repository paths). `needs` lists the ids a gate waits for; gates without needs between them run in parallel. Optional per gate: `fix` (auto-fix command), `note` (guidance when it is red).

full.name: third-party notices current
full.note: Red when Cargo.lock changed without regenerating the license notices: run the fix command and commit the regenerated THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES*.txt with the change — review them, don't revert them.

full.name: agent skills in sync
full.note: Shared skills are edited in amigo-labs/skills and synced with `node .agents/sync.mjs`; this repository's own skills are edited in .agents/skills, then `node .agents/sync.mjs --mirror`.
